svg.title: The same small design, a flower with two leaves, a swirl and three dots, painted in three palettes. Analogous: magenta petals, purple leaves, violet swirl, pink dots and a pale pink center. Complementary: blue petals, navy leaves, sky-blue swirl and orange center and dots. Monochrome plus accent: green petals, dark green leaves, lime swirl and a yellow center and dots as the accent.
